declaration.preface: Permeshwar Creations is a renowned apparel manufacturing company in India, known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability. At Permeshwar Creations, we pride ourselves on being a leader in the apparel manufacturing industry. Since our inception, we have been dedicated to producing high-quality garments that meet the needs of our diverse clientele. Our research and development team continuously innovate, creating lightweight, fine-textured garments in a variety of beautiful colors and designs.
declaration.declaration: Permeshwar Creations recognizes the importance of sustainable procurement practices in mitigating environmental impact and promoting social responsibility. We aim to integrate environmental and labor/human rights issues into our supply chain management, alongside traditional procurement considerations of price, quality, and reliability.
declaration.scope: This policy covers all aspects of Permeshwar Creation’s operations, including manufacturing, transportation, and product lifecycle management. It applies to all workers, employees, suppliers, and stakeholders involved in our operations. This policy applies to below mentioned locations:

Supplier Environmental Practices: Commitment to sourcing materials and products from suppliers with strong environmental management systems.
Supplier Social Practices: Commitment to working with suppliers that uphold fair labor practices, including safe working conditions and equitable wages.
Product Sustainability: Encourage suppliers to provide products that are designed for durability, recyclability, and reduced environmental impact throughout their lifecycle.
Local Sourcing and Community Impact: Promote local sourcing to support regional economies and reduce transportation-related emissions.
Supplier Diversity and Inclusion: Foster partnerships with diverse suppliers, including minority-owned, women-owned, and small businesses.

targets.target: By 2025, achieve a 20% reduction in the environmental footprint of sourced materials and products compared to 2022 baseline levels.
Ensure 100% of suppliers comply with international labor standards by 2025, up from 80% in 2022.
Increase the percentage of products meeting sustainable design criteria to 50% by 2025, from 30% in 2022.
Increase local sourcing from 30% to 50% of total procurement by 2022.
Increase procurement spend with diverse suppliers to 25% by 2025, from 15% in 2022.

responsibilities.role: Every employee, director, officer, contractor, and agent of Permeshwar Creations
responsibilities.duty: The responsibility for implementing and upholding this policy lies with every employee, director, officer, contractor, and agent of Permeshwar Creations.

responsibilities.role: Senior management, led by the Human Resource Manager (HR)
responsibilities.duty: Oversee policy execution and provide necessary resources for successful implementation.

policy.monitoring: Regular audits and reporting will ensure ongoing compliance with the policy's objectives and principles.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will undergo annual reviews overseen by the Health, Right and Safety Manager, with the next review scheduled for 1st January 2025. Updates or amendments will be communicated to all stakeholders accordingly.
